visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair tied back sits on a beige sofa, holding a long yellow plush dinosaur toy. She wears a brown plaid jumpsuit over a black tank top. A large pink rectangular overlay covers the center of the frame containing text and social media message bubbles. The background consists of off-white curtains and a small wooden side table with a lamp. (2) The camera cuts to a medium close-up of the woman’s face as she speaks directly to the lens with an expressive, slightly annoyed facial expression. Large white subtitles with black outlines appear at the bottom. (3) An extreme close-up of the woman's face follows; she holds a finger to her lips in a 'shushing' gesture while smiling mischievously. Animated poop emojis pop up around her head on screen. (4) The scene transitions to a screen recording of a mobile messaging interface (Instagram DM). A finger icon points at various UI elements, demonstrating how to select custom emoji reactions. The background of the UI is dark gray. (5) Back to the physical scene, the woman is seen again on the sofa, now looking frustrated. She grips the plush dinosaur tightly. Dynamic text overlays flash on screen in various sizes. (6) She begins to swing the plush toy around and shout, with rapid jump cuts accentuating her energetic movements. The lighting remains bright and consistent throughout the indoor setting. (7) The woman hits the sofa with the toy and looks away from the camera, ending the sequence with a final shot of the plush dinosaur resting on the cushion.
